scope_note: Bounded synthesis of the recorded conversation and current source. This enumerates major sector journeys; it does not claim exhaustive validation of every requested tool, record, provider or edge case.

evidence_policy.source_pointer: Code exists, not proof of live functionality

shared_studio_journeys.journey: Filter by sector, customer task, layout and supported channels → preview actual own content in existing four home designs or A/B recipe layouts → choose → undo/reorder/hide/edit → review → save exact revision.
edge_cases: Unsupported family/asset sizes not selectable as working
Mobile preview/device sizes are previews, not native proof

shared_studio_journeys.journey: Explicit microphone permission → capture/transcribe through configured provider → editable transcript → extract proposed structured edits → owner checks facts, tone, language and permissions → preview → approve save/publication separately.
edge_cases: No paid inference without configured budget/receipt
Speech synthesis/read-aloud differs from transcription or voice cloning

shared_studio_journeys.journey: Choose actual offer/event/recipe → brief and saved brand voice → draft caption/story/reel/post/email/print variants → safe-area preview → rights/source review → approve → supported channel publish/schedule → inspect per-channel receipts.
edge_cases: Provider not connected or scope revoked
No invented reviews, discounts, music rights or analytics

shared_studio_journeys.journey: Detach actual live preview DOM → drag/keyboard reposition/minimize → return to origin preserving state → clear on account/workspace change.
Read actual first-party actions and connected provider metrics → show date/source/confidence → explain next action → operator approves actual tool mutation.
edge_cases: Usage budgets and unknown paid-call state
Read-only suggestions do not claim completed actions

common_acceptance_cases: Correct record identity/branch/association separation
Authenticated role matrix: owner/admin/editor/viewer/outsider
Current owner transfer and revoked membership
Explicit owner null/clear and source refresh precedence
Version conflict with retained form and explicit reconciliation
Stable request nonce, payload mismatch and duplicate replay
Timeout/lost receipt: no blind replacement mutation
Reload recovery; actor/workspace fences and immediate DOM clearing
Missing/empty/blocked source data and broken images
Provider unavailable/revoked/rate-limited/partial outcome
Greek/English Unicode, long names, RTL locale where supported
Translation review; source language preserved and unknown locale honest
390px plus320px/tablet/1440px; safe areas/soft keyboard
Keyboard, focus restoration, screen-reader status and touch targets
Light/dark contrast and reduced motion
Loading/error/retry/offline distinctions
Moderation/private draft/public publication boundaries
Date-only versus exact time; timezone/DST and past records
Prices/currency/tax/deposit/paid receipt distinctions
External handoff clearly labeled; no fake in-app confirmation
Source, rendered and exercised-journey evidence recorded separately
Browser/native/source-only/deployed status distinguished
No synthetic public seeds or real customer messages during QA
Stale CDN/import dependency deployment ordering
Archive/delete retention and references preserved

sectors.name: Restaurants
owner_journeys: Claim exact branch → confirm menu, prices/currency, hours and photos → preview four designs → publish
Configure real booking resources/slots or enquiry → prepare promotion → approve channel variants
customer_journeys: Browse actual menu → dietary questions to business → reserve configured slot or send enquiry
Save visit plan → official ordering only when a real provider destination exists
permission_rules: Owner/admin/editor controls; viewer cannot mutate
Owner clears override imported menu/contact/media
provider_setup: Calendar/inventory must actually be configured
Ordering/payment links are explicit handoffs, not Zoi orders
Social OAuth/account scopes required for publishing
sector_edge_cases: Sold out, changed price, two diners competing for last slot
Allergens unknown; no inferred dietary safety
open_gaps: Branch-aware source completeness at inventory scale

sectors.name: Bakeries
owner_journeys: Edit real product/menu range, prices and seasonal offerings → preview → publish
Prepare celebration/custom-order enquiry and campaign variants
customer_journeys: Explore products → specify occasion/date/quantity → enquiry or actual checkout
required_data: Lead time when business supplies it
permission_rules: Workspace role/ownership checks
Do not overwrite explicit unavailable/removed products
provider_setup: Checkout requires actual products/variants/stock and provider
Enquiry works separately from order confirmation
sector_edge_cases: Custom cake cannot be instant-priced without rules

sectors.name: Chefs and recipes
owner_journeys: Choose owned chef listing → author ingredients/steps/timers/video → A/B live preview → save private revision
Review conflicts and recover exact pending save → approve eventual publication separately
customer_journeys: Adjust servings → check ingredients → cook steps/timers → detach video → copy list
required_data: Video permission/source and optional regional citation
permission_rules: Private owner/admin/editor drafts; actor-bound request receipts
No public recipe publication contract currently
provider_setup: Validated video embedding is not availability proof
Speech capability check and explicit start/stop
Shopping purchase only with real matched product IDs
sector_edge_cases: Timer sleep/reload, no closed-app alarm promise
open_gaps: Voice commands and regional editorial review

sectors.name: Churches and parishes
owner_journeys: Verify exact parish identity → edit services/ministries/contact → publish actual calendar
Schedule volunteers or guardian programmes → roster/attendance in authorized tools
Prepare multilingual parish announcement variants
customer_journeys: Find correct same-name parish by city/country → view actual services/calendar → volunteer or guardian enrolment
required_data: Actual service records versus reference feasts
permission_rules: Roster restricted roles; children never public
Institution/diocese data cannot masquerade as parish-owned
Guardian and instructor scopes distinct
provider_setup: Giving requires actual provider flow and receipt
No inferred livestream from channel link
Reference feast calculation is not a service booking
sector_edge_cases: Unpublished service privacy and volunteer cancellation

sectors.name: Monasteries
owner_journeys: Confirm exact monastery/source affiliation → edit visiting guidance/contact → publish permitted calendar
Review visitor enquiry and source attribution
customer_journeys: Find monastery → read supplied visiting guidance → contact or real visit request
required_data: Actual photos, accessibility and language when supplied
permission_rules: Only authorized institution workspace edits
No visitor/prayer-request details on public home
provider_setup: Do not claim room bookings or donations without configured backend
Official contact links may remain explicit handoffs
sector_edge_cases: 17-entry North America registry is not all Greece
Same dedication does not prove affiliation
Missing profile has no fake destination
Gender/visit conditions must be source supplied

sectors.name: Medical and allied professionals
owner_journeys: Confirm individual identity and supplied profession → edit contact/services/languages → preview → publish
Prepare factual professional introduction/campaign with review
customer_journeys: Understand actual discipline → save contact/vCard → prepare non-sensitive questions → configured booking or enquiry
required_data: Individual portrait, credentials and education as sourced
permission_rules: Professional source evidence does not establish current licence verification
No patient notes or medical records in general enquiries
provider_setup: Appointment provider requires real configuration
No diagnosis, insurance eligibility or treatment promises
sector_edge_cases: RN must not be labeled doctor/clinic
Association logo/socials cannot become person identity
open_gaps: Specialty-specific intake with proper privacy design

sectors.name: Lawyers and professional services
owner_journeys: Edit actual practice areas/languages/jurisdictions → preview → publish
Manage authorized matters/tasks/documents/time entries → prepare client communication
customer_journeys: Review services → non-sensitive consultation checklist → actual enquiry/contact
required_data: Service descriptions and fee terms when supplied
permission_rules: Matter/document/financial access must be scoped
No privileged details in public profile or generic campaign prompts
provider_setup: E-signature, filings and payments require supported provider workflows
Ownr-style recordkeeping does not mean legal formation completed
sector_edge_cases: Translation does not constitute legal advice
open_gaps: Sensitive document review and client portal

sectors.name: Influencers and creators
owner_journeys: Connect actual accounts → edit bio/media kit → create brief/deliverables → review campaign variants → schedule supported channels
customer_journeys: Explore authentic media → collaboration enquiry → real campaign agreement path
required_data: Metrics with actual provider provenance and timestamps
permission_rules: Account OAuth scopes and workspace roles
Sponsor/client draft visibility; no inferred paid approval
provider_setup: Keys/provider review/scopes needed per social platform
Channel URL ≠ connected feed; connecting ≠ all analytics available
open_gaps: Authentic live analytics and monetization workflows

sectors.name: Singers, musicians and performers
owner_journeys: Edit actual artist identity/music/media → review tour/source cards → approve appearances
Review city demand → plan promotion and supported show/trip handoffs
customer_journeys: Listen via real provider → explore shows → request city → discuss/share → plan actual trip/event
required_data: Sourced dated shows versus owner-confirmed appearances
permission_rules: Demand privacy and authenticated own requests
No source photo/label asset inherited from another artist
provider_setup: Spotify/YouTube playback subject to provider
Ticketing and booking require actual event/provider IDs
sector_edge_cases: Date-only events have no invented timezone
Full-page navigation does not guarantee continuous audio
open_gaps: Rights-aware release uploads and fan membership commerce

sectors.name: Dance companies and groups, including children
owner_journeys: Configure adult and guardian programmes separately → publish terms/capacity → approve enrolment
Assign current instructors → rehearsal calendar/attendance → festival participation
customer_journeys: Choose correct company/programme/age range → adult signup or guardian-managed child enrolment → review status/withdraw
required_data: Guardian authority, instructor assignment, capacity and actual sessions
permission_rules: No child public profile/contact/photos by default
Guardian self-attestation is not safeguarding certification
Only authorized instructors access assigned rosters
provider_setup: Payment only if actual setup; registration ≠ paid enrolment
Native guardian flow currently needs explicit safe web handoff until parity accepted
sector_edge_cases: Unknown write cannot be discarded and repeated

sectors.name: Sports clubs, leagues and athletes
owner_journeys: Distinguish club from league → configure season/teams/fixtures → record authorized results
Prepare registration, sponsor and match announcement variants
customer_journeys: Find club/team → inspect actual fixtures/results → supported registration/contact
permission_rules: Team/league operator permissions
Youth player privacy; no inferred consent for public roster
provider_setup: Payments/tickets/streaming only when configured
External professional sports feeds need actual licensed/provider source
sector_edge_cases: Club such as Olympic Flame is not a league
National/pro athlete identity separate from amateur teams

sectors.name: Venues and coordinated events
owner_journeys: Edit real spaces/capacities/layout reference → calibrate organizer plan → publish actual availability
Coordinate church/hall/band resources all-or-none → review quote/policies
customer_journeys: Compare spaces → select supported slots → atomic confirmation or explicit enquiry
permission_rules: Private event plan scoped to organizer
Providers see only explicitly supplied relevant context
provider_setup: No external availability or travel-time invention
Payments/deposits separate actual receipts
sector_edge_cases: Layout images are organizer provided, not guaranteed sightlines

sectors.name: Festivals and ticketed events
owner_journeys: Publish real event dates/packages/seat plan → manage applications/orders → campaign variants
customer_journeys: Explore actual event → select real package/seat → checkout/confirmation → manage eligible changes
permission_rules: Organizer/vendor/operator roles
Applicant and attendee details remain private
provider_setup: Actual checkout/webhook receipts required
A held seat is not a paid ticket
sector_edge_cases: Accessible seating information only if supplied

sectors.name: Hotels and accommodation
owner_journeys: Claim exact property → edit real rooms/dining/meeting offerings → configure supported provider or enquiry
Prepare seasonal campaign from supplied offers
customer_journeys: Choose dates/party/room interests → supported official booking destination or enquiry → confirmed outcome only from real backend
permission_rules: Owner fields and null clears beat sources
Guest enquiry access restricted
provider_setup: Appointment slots are not overnight hotel inventory
Provider parameters only when actually supported
sector_edge_cases: Email draft is not submitted booking

sectors.name: Car, motorcycle and equipment rentals
owner_journeys: Configure actual resources/locations/prices/policies where supported → preview customer journey
Create source-backed rental offer variants
customer_journeys: Choose collection/return dates/location → actual availability/quote → confirmation
required_data: Intervals, age/licence/deposit rules supplied by operator
permission_rules: Operator inventory access
Do not collect licence/payment details in generic notes
provider_setup: Rental provider setup required for external fleet
No unsupported overnight/rental guarantees from appointment engine
sector_edge_cases: Deposit is not captured payment until receipt

sectors.name: Property professionals and listings
owner_journeys: Manage authorized property offers/photos/features → preview → publish → handle enquiries
Prepare media variants with exact offer terms
customer_journeys: Filter real published offers → inspect location/photos → enquiry or configured viewing
permission_rules: Current host ownership and public moderation
Enquirer details private; unpublished offers excluded
provider_setup: MLS/portal feeds require actual integration
Mortgage/valuation tools need qualified sourced models
sector_edge_cases: Neighbourhood imagery not represented as property interior

remaining_platform_scope: Community social graph/media/feed quality and native parity
All-listing enrichment, duplicate resolution and criterion-level QA
Continuous mobile/device acceptance and deployment readiness
prohibited_completion_shortcuts: HTTP200 or field presence as full journey pass
Simulated sample data as real customer activity
